## 简体中文

### 性能

- 仅在可见时捕获镜像托盘图标，共享捕获任务，并根据内容变化调整刷新频率。
- 复用未变化的托盘帧并批量读取辅助功能信息，减少图像处理和状态项发现开销。
- 将时钟更新与任务栏隔离，缓存日期格式和文本测量，仅在需要时构建时钟工具提示。
- 按进程 ID 批量查询 Dock 徽标并复用共享的运行中应用列表，减少子进程和应用查找开销。
- 监听系统状态变化时使用更慢的兜底刷新，并仅在需要时启用全局指针监听。

### 修复

- 日历浮窗关闭时停止相关工作；设置窗口隐藏时暂停日期和时间预览，重新显示后以当前时间恢复并保留所选页面和子页面。

## English

### Performance

- Captured mirrored tray icons only while visible, shared capture work, and adapted refresh frequency to changing content.
- Reused unchanged tray frames and batched Accessibility reads to reduce image processing and status-item discovery overhead.
- Isolated clock updates from the taskbar, cached date formatting and text measurements, and built clock tooltips only when needed.
- Batched Dock badge queries by process ID and reused the shared running-app list to reduce subprocess and application lookup overhead.
- Observed system status changes with a slower fallback refresh, and enabled global pointer monitoring only while needed.

### Fixed

- Stopped calendar work while its flyout is closed and paused date/time previews while the settings window is hidden, resuming with the current time and preserving the selected page and subpage when shown again.
